result.instructions: Tools for Fieldwire, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my construction projects and where each one is located."; "Show all open tasks on the Maple Street project."; "Which RFIs on the Maple Street project are still waiting for an answer?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fieldwire data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fieldwire_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fieldwire_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fieldwire_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. fieldwire_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Fieldwire account this API token belongs to: id, company name and address, enabled modules (submittals, change orders, RFIs, specs, BIM) and the owner. GET /account on the account host.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_account_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: All users on the account (and users invited to its projects) with name, company, email, account role and the number of projects each is in. User ids are what tasks use for owner and assignees. GET /account/users on the account host.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Projects the token's user can access in the region chosen at login: id, name, code, address, time zone, plan and archive state. Filter by name, code, archive state or update time. Use the id in every other tool. GET /api/v3/projects.

name_contains.description: Only projects whose name contains this text.

code.description: Only the project with this exact project code.

archived.description: true = only archived projects, false = only unarchived.

updated_after.description: Only projects updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_before.description: Only projects updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

state.description: Only active records (the usual) or only deleted ones. Sent as the Fieldwire-Filter header.

last_synced_at.description: Cursor for the next page: the previous reply's next_last_synced_at, unchanged. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project by id: name, code, address, time zone, currency, plan, enabled features and owner email. GET /api/v3/projects/{id}.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_project_users
tools.title: List project users
tools.description: Users on one project with name, company, job title, email and phone. The integer id is what tasks use for owner_user_id and user_ids. Filter by email, name or company. GET /api/v3/account/projects/{project_id}/users.

email_contains.description: Only users whose email contains this text.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Tasks (punch items, issues) in a project: name, status_id, team_id, location_id, floorplan_id, owner and assignee user ids, priority, dates and cost. Filter by status, team, location, plan, owner, name, tag and dates. Resolve ids with fieldwire_list_task_statuses, _list_teams, _list_locations and _list_project_users. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/tasks.

status_id.description: Only tasks with this status id.

team_id.description: Only tasks of this team (shown as 'category' in the Fieldwire app).

floorplan_id.description: Only tasks pinned on this plan (floorplan).

owner_user_id.description: Only tasks owned by this user id.

creator_user_id.description: Only tasks created by this user id.

name_contains.description: Only tasks whose name contains this text.

tag.description: Only tasks with exactly this tag.

due_after.description: Only tasks due on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd) or date-time.

due_before.description: Only tasks due on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd) or date-time.

created_after.description: Only tasks created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only tasks created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_after.description: Only tasks updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_before.description: Only tasks updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

state.description: Only active records (the usual) or only deleted ones. Sent as the Fieldwire-Filter header.

last_synced_at.description: Cursor for the next page: the previous reply's next_last_synced_at, unchanged. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_task

state.description: Only active records (the usual) or only deleted ones. Sent as the Fieldwire-Filter header.

state.description: Only active records (the usual) or only deleted ones. Sent as the Fieldwire-Filter header.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_form
tools.title: Get form
tools.description: One form by id (header data only, not the filled-in values). GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/forms/{id}.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_form_full
tools.title: Get form with all values
tools.description: A form with its sections, inputs and filled-in values. Two steps: call without jid to start the job (Fieldwire answers with a jid); then call again with that jid until the form comes back (answer 'pending' means not ready, retry). GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/forms/{id}/full.

jid.description: The jid returned by the first call; leave out to start.

tools.name: fieldwire_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new task in a project. It is sent once and never retried; if the reply is an error, check fieldwire_list_tasks before creating it again, or you may get a duplicate. owner_user_id and priority are required; creator_user_id defaults to the owner. Find user ids with fieldwire_list_project_users. POST /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/tasks.

floorplan_id.description: Plan (floorplan) id the task belongs to - see fieldwire_list_floorplans.

owner_user_id.description: User id of the task owner (required) - see fieldwire_list_project_users.

user_ids.description: User ids of the assignees. On an update this REPLACES the whole assignee list.

start_at.description: Start, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone.

end_at.description: End, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone.

man_power_value.description: Estimated man-power (hours, days or months as set in the project).

creator_user_id.description: User id recorded as creator (default: the owner).

tools.name: fieldwire_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of one task (only the fields you pass; user_ids replaces the whole assignee list; null clears a field that allows it). Use it to set the status, owner, assignees, priority or dates. It does not delete the task. Sent once, never retried. PATCH /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/tasks/{id}.

status_id.description: Status id - see fieldwire_list_task_statuses; null removes the status.

team_id.description: Team (category) id; null removes the team.

location_id.description: Location id; null removes the location.

floorplan_id.description: Plan (floorplan) id; null removes the plan.

owner_user_id.description: User id of the task owner - see fieldwire_list_project_users.

user_ids.description: User ids of the assignees. REPLACES the whole assignee list; null removes all assignees.

due_date.description: Due date, yyyy-mm-dd; null removes the due date.

start_at.description: Start, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone; null removes it.

end_at.description: End, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone; null removes it.

cost_value.description: Cost of the task; null removes it.
